exposure: Standardized surgical technique for primary cesarean deliveries
cohort: Women undergoing primary cesarean delivery before and after implementation of a standardized surgical technique
finding: Implementation of a standardized surgical technique for primary cesarean deliveries, combined with surgical experience, can reduce total operative time and incision-to-delivery time without increasing maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: A standardized surgical technique combined with surgical experience can decrease total operative time and incision-to-delivery time in primary CD without increasing maternal morbidity.
